history.representation: one exact host token-ID row per committed position
history.append_rule: reuse only when the complete committed history is a prefix of the requested history
history.same_rule: return session-owned last logits and hidden state without evaluation
history.shorter_or_divergent_rule: clear all persistent CUDA state and replay the request from position zero
history.invalid_input_rule: validate the complete request before reset or execution

session_owned_outputs.reason: a no-op sync is independent of which scratch workspace the caller supplies

exact_admission: all GDN convolution and recurrent bytes
all committed attention key and value cache rows below the frontier

memory_boundary.reason: one snapshot at every 131072 positions cannot fit the product memory budget
memory_boundary.arbitrary_rollback: deterministic replay in SES-001; explicit disk checkpoints are SES-003

deferred: atomic rollback after CUDA failure or cancellation (completed by SES-002)
